title: Figure 8: Free-electron laser wiggler
description: Color schematic of alternating-polarity N and S magnet blocks arranged in two rows, with an "Injected electron beam micropulse" entering from the left and "Output radiation" and "Spent electron beam" exiting at the right. Wiggler period λw and radiation wavelength λr are marked. Caption reads "Figure 8. Free-Electron Laser Wiggler."
